Definition: from G5350; utterance, i.e. a musical note (vocal or instrumental):--sound.
BiblicalUsage: Phthongos is a sound, a note, a voice carrying where words travel. Paul says the sound of the preachers went into all the earth in Romans 10:18, and that even a pipe or harp must give a distinct sound to be understood in 1 Corinthians 14:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God meant His message to be heard clearly, not as noise nobody can follow.
